question: A cylindrical tin is $15 \mathrm{~cm}$ high. The circumference of the base circle is $30 \mathrm{~cm}$. An ant walks from point $A$ at the base to point $B$ at the top. Its path is partly vertically upwards and partly along horizontal circular arcs. Its path is drawn in bold on the diagram (with a solid line on the front and a dashed line at the back). How long is the total distance covered by the ant? <image1>
subject: solid geometry
